title: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
abstract: arXiv:2611.18891v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

translated_title: 让语言回归动作：通过参数合并恢复VLA模型中的VLM能力
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）是通过在机器人演示数据上微调预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）而得到的，从而能够根据视觉观察和语言指令进行动作预测。然而，这种微调会引发灾难性遗忘，显著降低原始VLM的语义理解和视觉定位能力。我们通过合并VLM与其VLA衍生模型的参数来解决这一问题，且无需对任一模型进行重新训练。具体而言，我们提取任务向量（即VLA与VLM权重之间的差异），并通过奇异值分解（SVD）对其进行分解。对于每个分量，我们学习一个标量混合系数，用于控制保留多少VLA的适应能力，并通过优化来同时保持动作预测和视觉-语言能力。实验表明，我们的合并模型在这两方面均表现良好，始终优于现有的参数合并基线方法。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需重新训练的参数合并方法，通过对任务向量进行奇异值分解并为每个分量学习标量混合系数，同时保留VLA模型的动作预测能力和原始VLM的视觉-语言能力，有效缓解微调带来的灾难性遗忘。
